'''Topi Topi''' was a [[Wayuning]] from [[Ardennia]]. By [[34 ABY]], a [[bounty]] had been posted on Topi Topi for stealing a [[Kowakian monkey-lizard]] from the [[Creature Stall]] in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Batuu]]. While they were hiding out in the outpost, Topi Topi's location was reported to the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. In [[35 ABY]], Topi Topi attended the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] on the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]].

==Biography==
Topi Topi was a [[Wayuning]] whose [[homeworld]] was [[Ardennia]]. During the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Batuu|occupation]] of the planet [[Batuu]]<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="GEDates">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]], including ''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]'', to [[34 ABY]].</ref> there was an outstanding 14000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] [[bounty]] on Topi Topi for having falsely impersonated a creature caretaker and stealing a [[Kowakian monkey-lizard]] from the [[Creature Stall]] in the [[Black Spire Outpost Market|market]] of [[Black Spire Outpost]] on Batuu.<ref name="Bounty Hunters" />

[[File:TopiTopi-TROS.png|thumb|left|300px|Topi Topi attended the Festival of the Ancestors on the planet Pasaana.]]
The bounty also charged Topi Topi with having evaded arrest, and the Wayuning was hiding in one of the buildings of the outpost when the bounty was assigned by the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]] to a individual visiting the outpost. Using a [[thermal scanner]], the individual discovered Topi Topi's location and reported it back to the local [[Guildmaster's Hideout]] in order to claim the reward.<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> Topi Topi attended the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] in the [[Forbidden Valley]] of the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]]. While walking between the various stalls set up for the festival, the Wayuning passed by a group of [[Resistance]] agents searching for a [[Sith wayfinder]].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Topi Topi wore a large [[Color|brown]] woven hat and a red and black stripped [[Clothing|robe]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Topi Topi first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="TROS" /> The character was identified as part of ''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]'', an augmented reality [[Star Wars video games|video game]] launched at [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney World|Walt Disney World]]<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> on [[July 27]], [[2022]].<ref name="DPB Launching">{{DPB|url=2022/07/magicbandplus-launching-july-27-at-walt-disney-world|text=MagicBand+ Launching July 27 at Walt Disney World|nolive=1}}</ref>
